source_analysis: PDF coverage: HTML/CSS/JavaScript/npm; static/interactivity checkpoints; Git/GitHub; Tailwind/React; collaboration/frontend app; backend/Node; REST/CRUD/JWT/Redis/Linux/Postgres; AWS EC2/VPC/Route53/SES/S3; monitoring; GitHub Actions; Ansible/Terraform.
analysis_method: Extracted labels from the one-page source PDF and visually reviewed the rendered roadmap layout; regrouped prerequisites into a sequential learning path and expanded topics for practical projects and production work.
learning_sequence: Follow stages and nodes in order. Optional specialization can be revisited after the capstone.
